request.description: Compiles the draft (lender from the key, catalog keys, GST state codes and city ids, conditions on known attributes, active document types, published question set) and opens a change request. Staff only. Lender products are versioned config (an ops lead or lender manager makes, a different staff member approves in Change Requests, then it is published). The key is `<lenderKey>.<productKey>`; the lender comes from the key. `content`: `category`, `segments`, `subSegments` (empty = all), `amountPaise` and `tenureMonths` ranges, `coverage` (`nationwide`, `states` as GST codes, `cityIds`, `includePincodes`, `excludePincodes`), `eligibility.hard[]` / `soft[]` rules (`id`, `when` condition, optional `minProvenance`, `party`: primary / any_co_applicant / all_directors, `pass` / `fail` texts; soft rules carry a `weight`), `documents[]` slots with a `stage`, optional `questionSet` and `pricingDisclosure`. Only products of active lenders with an agreement in force count for category availability, lender questions and matching.
